whatIs: Jitter is a motion design tool that runs in the browser: you build animations on a canvas, start from one of its more than 400 free templates or describe the idea to its AI, and then fine-tune it by hand. It supports curves with the pen tool, gradients, animated blur, audio, video and more than 1,500 fonts.
It's a good fit for design and product teams who want to animate pieces (ads, social posts, interfaces) without learning After Effects, and who need to export to video, GIF or Lottie.
uses: Creating a launch animation for social media from a template.
Exporting a Lottie animation to use in an app or website.
Generating a short GIF that shows a feature in a README or an article.
caveats: The free plan exports up to 720p at 30 fps, with a watermark and 3 files per workspace.
Exporting in 1080p and without a watermark requires a paid plan; 4K, batch export and transparent background are on higher plans.
AI credits are limited on the free plan, and uploads can't exceed 20 MB.
pricingNote: Free plan with a watermark and 720p; Pro, Max and Ultra are charged per editor, with a discount for annual billing.
idealFor: Designers and teams who animate visual pieces without motion design experience.
